title: Double Slit
summary: Explore interference, detection, trajectories, and branching in the double-slit experiment.

resourceNotes.double-slit-analytical-simulation: 1. Start with interference and compare three accounts.
resourceNotes.double-slit-notebook: 2. The notebook: interference, single detections, which-slit records and three accounts, then the full equation with reflection and pilot-wave trajectories (N-Slits embedded).
resourceNotes.n-slits: 3. N-Slits: 1 to 8 slits, detectors, slits closed during a run, three levels, and two engines: the analytical model and the full Schrödinger equation (reflection from the wall, trajectories).
resourceNotes.weak-velocity-double-slit: Optional advanced study: weak measurement and reconstructed probability flow.
